explanation: Matches Pollington (Illinois J. Math 1979) as summarized in search results and in arXiv:2412.11062: for lacunary (n_k), the set of ξ with {n_kξ} not dense has Hausdorff dimension 1, also obtained by de Mathan. IsLacunary is eventual, which is harmless, and dimH on ℝ with value 1 is the claim.
